integrity.message: battery matches the baseline: 10 perturbations, 1483 preserving and 1065 breaking observations

procedure: The perturbation battery of `scripts/stress-cosine.ts` re-run against the current scorer at the baseline's own sample (300 icons of the house variant, seed 1) and compared to `bench/stress-cosine.v1.json`. Pooled AUC may fall 0.02 below the baseline and any single perturbation's own AUC 0.05, both set from the seed-to-seed spread the baseline itself reports: 0.008 pooled over seeds 1..5, up to 0.041 for a single perturbation. Before comparing, the run's family sizes are checked against the baseline's — a battery that has been shortened produces a different experiment, and its AUC is not comparable to the number it would be compared against. The baseline file is checked against a digest pinned in this script, and every path that defines what passing means is checked for uncommitted edits.
verdict: PASS: pooled AUC 0.864 against a baseline of 0.864 (+0.000), no perturbation down more than 0.05. The scorer still separates a broken drawing from an intact one as well as it did when the benchmark was calibrated. It says nothing about whether the scorer is *good* — the baseline it is held to has an inverted gradient on translation and cannot see a dot two tiers too large.
